story.challenge: Balancing user experience against strict HIPAA requirements while adding telehealth.
story.solution: A HIPAA-compliant platform with end-to-end encryption, secure patient portal and integrated video sessions.
story.impact: 625 new clients in year one, full HIPAA compliance, patient satisfaction up 85%, admin work down 60%.

testimonial.text: As a psychology practice, HIPAA compliance is absolutely critical. Elan delivered a secure, professional website with a patient portal that meets all requirements. The marketing campaign brought in 625 new clients in our first year!
testimonial.author: Douglas Uhlig, Ph.D.
